AC3 — codeql.yml and terraform-drift.yml drop their push key outright
AC4 — Push CI for NON-main branches is preserved

AC8 — codeql.yml keeps weekly cron 23 4 * * 1, gains no 6-hourly cron
AC9 — terraform-drift.yml keeps daily cron 17 6 * * *, gains no 6-hourly cron
